verdict.rationale: pnpm is a local CLI package manager, but a machine-readable interface spec (OpenAPI or an equivalent schema) is still a fair ask for developer tooling. The evidence shows none: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path on pnpm.io returned 404. The only machine-readable output found is JSON audit reports, which is an adjacent feature and not an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
